description: Title is present
Brand is present
Product is classified in a leaf category
Price is present
All attributes required by the category are filled
Description or bullet points are present
Food products state a net quantity (g or ml)
Price is strictly positive
Colour is in the controlled list
Size is on the agreed scale (XXS-3XL, EU shoe size, bed size, or one size)
GTIN/EAN check digit is valid when a barcode is given
Title length is between 10 and 200 characters
Title is not written in capitals
Title language is English (other languages are kept and tagged)
Currency is USD
Price is within 3.5 robust z-scores of its category (log scale)
Size and weight are plausible for the category (log scale robust z)
A colour named in the title agrees with the colour field
Brand matches the brand reference table exactly (not a near-miss spelling)
The text classifier does not confidently place the product in another category
in_stock agrees with stock quantity
Variants of one parent share brand and category
The source colour maps to the controlled list (no unknown colour words)
SKU is unique
No other SKU is the same product (cross-source duplicate cluster)
Colour/size variants are grouped under one parent, not listed as separate products
